theory.title: Exercise 2.4.5: Nested Loops
theory.content:
🔄 Loops Within Loops

MENTOR-9: "You've mastered single loops. But what if you have categories AND items? Zones AND systems?"

"Nested loops! The outer loop picks a zone, the inner loop checks every system IN that zone. Multiply your iterations!"

📘 Nested Loop Structure

Pattern:

FOR    ${outer}    IN    @{outer_list}
    # Outer loop body
    FOR    ${inner}    IN    @{inner_list}
        # Inner loop body (runs for EACH outer iteration)
        Log    ${outer} - ${inner}
    END
    # Back to outer loop
END
  • Outer loop iterates once per outer item
  • Inner loop runs COMPLETELY for each outer iteration
  • Total iterations = outer × inner
  • Indentation increases by 4 spaces per level

💡 How Nested Loops Execute

@{zones}=    Create List    Alpha    Beta
@{systems}=    Create List    power    sensors

FOR    ${zone}    IN    @{zones}
    FOR    ${system}    IN    @{systems}
        Log    ${zone} - ${system}
    END
END

# Execution flow:
# 1. Outer: zone=Alpha
#    2. Inner: system=power → Log "Alpha - power"
#    3. Inner: system=sensors → Log "Alpha - sensors"
# 4. Outer: zone=Beta
#    5. Inner: system=power → Log "Beta - power"
#    6. Inner: system=sensors → Log "Beta - sensors"

# Total: 2 zones × 2 systems = 4 iterations

⚙️ Key Rules

  • 🔹 Indentation critical: Inner loop indented +4 from outer
  • 🔹 END alignment: Each END aligns with its FOR
  • 🔹 Inner runs fully: Inner loop completes before outer advances
  • 🔹 Variable scope: Both ${outer} and ${inner} available in inner loop
  • 🔹 Multiplication: Total iterations = outer_count × inner_count

🎯 Your Task

Check 3 zones (Alpha, Beta, Gamma) with 3 systems each (power, sensors, life-support). That's 9 checks with nested loops!
